name: alignment
description: Aligned sequence reads or assembled sequences mapped to a reference.

name: signal track
description: Quantitative signal values across genomic coordinates including coverage, fold change, and p-values.

name: peak set
description: Discrete regions of enrichment identified by peak calling algorithms.

name: chromatin accessibility
description: Open chromatin regions and nuclease cleavage data from DNase-seq or ATAC-seq.

name: contact matrix
description: Pairwise interaction frequency data from chromosome conformation capture experiments.

name: dna methylation
description: Methylation state measurements at specific sequence contexts (CpG, CHG, CHH).

name: rna modification
description: Epitranscriptomic modification states including m6A, m5C, inosine, pseudouridine, and Nm.

name: regulatory element
description: Predicted or validated cis-regulatory elements including enhancers, promoters, and CREs.

name: element gene linkage
description: Statistical or predicted associations between regulatory elements and target genes.

name: crispr screen
description: Guide RNA libraries, perturbation signals, and quantifications from CRISPR screens.

name: count matrix
description: Sparse or dense count matrices from single-cell or bulk sequencing experiments.

name: quantification
description: Gene, transcript, exon, or protein expression measurements.

name: deep learning
description: Contribution scores, predicted signals, and outputs from trained genomic deep learning models.

name: replication timing
description: Replication timing profiles and relative replication signals.

name: variant
description: SNPs, indels, structural variants, and QTL associations.

name: reference
description: Genome assemblies, indices, and reference sequences.

name: sequence motif
description: Position weight matrices, motif instances, and sequence signatures.

name: annotation
description: Genome annotations, transcript models, and feature tracks.

name: single cell
description: Cell-level coordinates, annotations, and clustering results from single-cell experiments.

name: structure
description: Three-dimensional structural data and predicted ensembles.

name: haplotype
description: Haplotype assignments and phased mapping data.

name: technical
description: Raw instrument output, adapters, barcodes, and technical artifacts.
